messages:
maria_g: Heads-up — PM asked for a small UX in Console: a live 'Routing impact' preview that shows how switching routing policies affects per-route token cost and cache savings. wants it in next sprint.
jake_r: +1. We already compute per-request marginal cost in the backend; question is what granularity do we display? per-invocation? per-route-avg? :thinking_face:
priya: we should surface both: an 'expected marginal cost' for the route and a distribution (p50/p95) so customers see variance from model hotpaths.
leo: For cache savings, we need to be explicit about attribution. Do we show 'claimed' prefetch credits or 'estimated' shared-savings? we have both signals in telemetry but different accuracy.
maria_g: PM wants something conservative — show estimated savings + a confidence badge. avoid overpromising credits on invoices.
jake_r: Implementation thought: expose a new field in internal usage API: token_cost_breakdown: {
  "compute_tokens": 123,
  "kv_cache_hit_tokens": 45,
  "prefetch_credit": 12
}
That payload is simple to add to the per-invocation telemetry.
priya: Can we avoid nesting in the public SDK? maybe return flattened keys like token_cost_compute / token_cost_cache / token_credit_prefetch — keeps front-end charting simple.
leo: Also need to consider sampling — we don't sample cache hits reliably for very high throughput tenants. If we just extrapolate, the preview could be off by 20-30%.
sam_ops: we have an internal sampler that tags 1% requests with full lineage (route, model, cache_key). if frontend requests a preview, we can compute estimate from the last 24h sampled corpus and show a confidence interval.
maria_g: That aligns with PM ask. UX copy: "Estimated per-invocation cost (last 24h sample) — includes cache & prefetch credits. Confidence: medium". simple.
jake_r: One API debate: should the preview be computed synchronously on request (fast query) or precomputed nightly per-route per-model? realtime is expensive.
priya: Precompute + quick realtime delta for recent traffic. precompute gives stable p50/p95 distributions and realtime adjusts for recent firmware/traffic shifts.
leo: Rollout plan: feature flag gated. start with internal-only, then alpha on a handful of tenants with high telemetry fidelity.
deploy-bot: new rollout flag created: feature.cost_routing_preview (owner: @maria_g) — canary buckets: internal, alpha, open
sam_ops: Note: we need an RBAC check — don't leak other tenants' aggregation. previews must be scoped to the requesting tenant's routes only.
maria_g: Agreed. Also add a toggled explanation for "How we estimate savings" linking to docs.
jake_r: One more internal API change: add route_hint to running requests so cache_key lineage attaches to route cleanly. small patch to proxy code.
priya: I'll sketch console wireframes tomorrow. Can someone from infra estimate precompute storage & compute? @leo?
leo: ballpark — for 10k routes, storing p50/p95 + counts per model per route is ~1.2GB daily. compute is a cron job that scans sampled traces; should be fine on an m5.xlarge for a few hours.
maria_g: Great. next steps: priya wires, jake & leo design backend contract, sam set sampling/flag, I'll add acceptance criteria for confidence badge. I'll create a GH issue.
sam_ops: added a quick note: "preview must show sampling rate and raw sample size" — helps customers interpret numbers.
jake_r: ok landing plan looks good. will open PR for API field names after wireframes.
maria_g: thanks all. small follow-up: keep copy short and avoid mentioning invoices — this is for planning only. :thumbsup:"
